BrochureContent.Content:
Charming bright spacious two bedroom first floor apartment located in the highly desirable Bealach Na Gaoithe estate comes to market with the added bonus of a private walled garden. Enjoying a quiet corner location on a sleepy horseshoe to the front of the estate, Number 19a will delight prospective buyers, offering a wealth of excellent features. This wonderful first floor apartment will appeal to a wide audience of buyers making an ideal first time purchase or indeed excellent investment opportunity. Those looking to downsize will appreciate its highly convenient location with a host of amenities on offer.

The accommodation is deceptively spacious, briefly comprising of an inviting entrance hall, a well proportioned front reception that will cater for the needs of both living and dining, fully fitted kitchen, two good sized double bedrooms, master ensuite and main bathroom. 

The much sought after Bealach Na Gaoithe Estate enjoys a highly convenient location. Located just off the Galway Road the property is within easy walking distance to Tuam Town with a wealth of amenities to hand, boasting a wide selection of shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, leisure facilities, a wonderful public park and excellent schools. Bus Eireann, Burke's Bus and GoBus service the area providing excellent services to Galway and beyond; the access to the M17 motorway is only metres away making commuting hassle free.

Contact our office today to avoid disappointment!

Hardwood door leads to an inviting L shaped entrance hall with warm ceramic tile flooring that is further complemented by the soft colour palette; hot press with dual immersion insulated water cylinder and storage shelving above; access to attic via trap door; Door to;

Living/Dining Area: 3.17m x 2.77m; 2.39m x 4.39m
Two large window openings flood this wonderful open plan themed living space that due to its clever design offers both a spacious living room and well defined dining area; attractive solid oak flooring with hollow core floors beneath complement the warm welcoming colour palette; the generous living space leads on to the well defined dining area that will comfortably accommodate a good size dining suite; as well as being an excellent source of natural light the large window openings offer a leafy outlook to the large green area across from the property; TV point; telephone point; Door to;

Kitchen: 2.60m x 3.08m
Located off this fine living space one is greeted by a beautiful light filled kitchen/breakfast room; a stunning high specification fitted kitchen dresses two walls offering an abundance of storage options from the generous array of wall and base fitted units with ample worktop space and stylish tile splash back; fitted four place ceramic hob with concealed extractor overhead and fitted oven beneath; plumbed and space provision for washing machine, dishwasher and fridge freezer; a stainless steel sink unit enjoys a most pleasant window aspect that also gives the room a great source of natural light; warm ceramic tiled flooring is complemented further by the soft colour palette.

Bedroom One: 2.59m x 3.08m
Fine size bright double bedroom located to the rear of the property that is filled with light from the large window opening complementing the attractive solid oak flooring and warm colour palette; fitted wardrobe offers good storage options; TV point; telephone point; Door to:

Ensuite: 0.96m x 2.27m
This well presented ensuite enjoys great natural light from the large privacy glass window opening; modern three piece white coloured suite comprising of push button flush WC, wash hand basin with mirror and shavers light above and large walk in shower with Triton T90z fitted electric shower; tastefully tiled from floor to ceiling; Creda wall mounted heater; extractor fan.

Bedroom Two: 2.69m x 4.29m
This bright spacious double bedroom also located to the rear of the property enjoys excellent room proportions with attractive solid oak flooring further complemented by the warm colour palette; fitted wardrobes offers excellent storage; large window opening fills the room with light.

Bathroom: 1.70m x 3.08m
Lovely bright well proportioned main bathroom owing to the large privacy glass window opening that floods the room with light; tastefully tiled from floor to ceiling with modern three piece white coloured suite comprising off push button flush WC, wash hand basin with mirror above and fitted bath unit with chrome hand shower extension.

Outside:
The property comes with the added benefit of its own private walled garden that is a rare but wonderful feature giving the discerning buyer a range of options on how to utilise the green space best; to the rear of the building through double gates there is a large secure tarmac communal parking area.
